test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A work can be finished by 10 men in 8 days and by 10 women in 7 days. In how many days will the work be finished if 10 women and 10 men work on alternate days, with the women starting on the first day?
solution:
**Given:**

10 men can complete the work in 8 days

10 women can complete the work in 7 days

**Concept:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Solution:**

According to question,

10M × 8 = 10W × 7

M : W = 7 : 8

Total work = 10 × 7 × 8 = 560 units

Total efficiency of Men and Women = 7 + 8 = 15

2 days work when 10 men and 10 women work on alternate days = 15 × 10 = 150 units

6 days work = 150 × 3 = 450 units

7th day 10 women work = 10 × 8 = 80 units

Remaining work = 560 - (450 + 80) = 30 units

10 men complete the remaining work = 30/(10 × 7) = 3/7 days

Total days taken to complete the work = 7 + 3/7 = 73over7days

**Hence, total days taken to complete the work 73over7days.**
